canonical_source.behavior: Retest each selected visible site using the real connection test, report aggregate success/failure truthfully, then reread the authoritative Sites collection.

laravel_adaptation.success: Every selected real recheck completes and the Sites collection is reread before a success status is rendered.
laravel_adaptation.partial_failure: Per-site recheck failures are counted and rendered as an alert after the authoritative reread.
laravel_adaptation.foreign_collection: The control is not rendered if the advertised Sites endpoint does not match the active tenant.

security_boundary.tenant_context: tenant.context scopes each recheck request and the collection read
security_boundary.permission: connector.manage is required by the existing real recheck endpoint and by the control
security_boundary.foreign_site: focused feature coverage proves a site owned by another tenant fails closed as 404
security_boundary.missing_authority: focused feature coverage proves a viewer without connector.manage receives 403

scope_exclusions: No adjacent Sites bulk actions are claimed
